_source: Built from ai-calling-kyc-proposal/data/kyc-proposal-field-graph.json (version 2026-09-18.1). Re-run domains/insurance/build_context.py after refreshing that pack. Do not hand-edit.
_status: live 2026-09-22 — app_flow and kyc_mandate are hand-built from screenshots and the product owner, not from the field graph
_limitations: Kotak has no numeric insurer_id in the current backend registry (1-9).
United in the matrix maps operationally to UIIC / insurer_id 6 pending string-code confirmation.
NIC and Digit each have multiple backend routes; field requirements here are label-level, not adapter-level.
Collection scripts, consent wording, and recording policy remain TBD.

Loan/lender field(s) shown when 'Was the car purchased on loan?' = Yes are not modelled here — per INSURANCE_KYC_KB.md 2026-09-21, exact fields must come from the backend/product spec, not be invented. The bot is scripted to defer to whatever the app screen shows.

Exact allowed nominee-relationship enumeration is not confirmed from backend/product spec (INSURANCE_KYC_KB.md open question #2) — prompt.py's existing 'family/trusted person' script stays the fallback until confirmed.

PEP definition text is a neutral standard explanation, not a Park+/product-owner-sanctioned line (unlike kyc_mandate/policy_delivery above) — confirm official wording before treating it as authoritative.

business.name: Park+ Insurance
business.purpose: Post-payment KYC and proposal completion for motor insurance
business.policy_source_framing: The policy is ISSUED by the insurer (ICICI Lombard, HDFC ERGO, ...), but the customer BOUGHT it on Park+. Say it that way — 'Park+ se li hui ICICI Lombard ki policy' — never 'aapne ICICI se liya', as if they went to the insurer directly: a caller told that says they never bought any insurance (live call 2026-09-23).

kyc_mandate._source: Park+ product owner, 2026-09-19, answering 'what do we tell a customer who asks what happens if they never finish KYC'.
kyc_mandate.why: IRDAI requires KYC on every insurance policy. Without it the insurer cannot issue the policy, however the payment went through.
kyc_mandate.deadline: There is no separate KYC deadline to quote. Until it is done the policy document is not issued, so sooner is better. The only date worth saying out loud is when the customer's EXISTING cover lapses, and that arrives on the call card as kyc_deadline_hint — never the new policy's end date, which is about a year out.
unknown_do_not_guess: whether the money is refunded, held, or lost if KYC is never completed
any IRDAI circular number, section, date or penalty
any cancellation date, grace period, or deadline other than policy expiry
whether cover is active in the meantime

sanctioned_lines.why: सर, IRDAI के rules के हिसाब से KYC complete हुए बिना insurance company policy issue नहीं कर सकती। बस दो मिनट का काम है।
sanctioned_lines.deadline: कोई last date तो नहीं है सर — पर जब तक KYC नहीं होती, policy document नहीं मिलेगा। अभी कर लेते हैं, दो मिनट लगेंगे।

policy_delivery._source: Park+ product owner, 2026-09-20. Replaces the bot's previous answer to 'policy कब आएगी?', which was 'मुझे इसका exact जवाब पता नहीं है' three times in one call.
policy_delivery.answer: Once the insurer's side verifies all the details, the policy arrives on WhatsApp and on email, and the app sends a notification too.
policy_delivery.still_unknown: How long that verification takes. Never give a date, a time or a number of days.
policy_delivery.sanctioned_line: सर, insurer की side से सारी details verify हो जाएँगी, फिर policy आपको WhatsApp और mail दोनों पे आ जाएगी — app में भी notification आ जाएगा।

button_not_found._source: Park+ product owner, 2026-09-20. The 14:55 call spent four turns on 'Complete KYC नहीं दिख रहा' with no ladder to climb.
button_not_found._note: 2026-09-24: the WhatsApp KYC link is now the call's MAIN path, sent by bot.py at call start (voicebot/server/whatsapp.py). This app ladder is the fallback for a link that never arrived, so its last step forwards to the team instead of promising the link again.
ladder: Insurance page पे देखिए सर, वहीं मिल जाएगा।
हाँ सर, insurance वाले page पे ही देखिए — 'Complete KYC' का button वहीं होता है।
एक काम कीजिए सर — app बंद करके दोबारा खोलिए, फिर insurance page पे देखिए।
सर, ये technical issue लग रहा है — मैं एक बार team को forward कर देती हूँ, वो आपकी help कर देंगे।
button_not_found.rule: Work down the ladder one step per turn. Forward to the team only after the app has been reopened and it is still not there.

name.label: Name
name.ask_hint: Ask for full name as on ID / proposal.

mobile.label: Mobile
mobile.ask_hint: Prefer confirming the number already on the case; update only if customer corrects it.

dob.label: DOB
dob.ask_hint: Collect date of birth as day-month-year and repeat it back.

gender.label: Gender
gender.ask_hint: Ask gender as required by the insurer form options.

correspondence_address.label: Correspondence address
correspondence_address.ask_hint: Collect full correspondence address line by line.

correspondence_city_state.label: Correspondence city/state
correspondence_city_state.ask_hint: HDFC only: capture city and state as shown in UI / form.

permanent_address.label: Permanent address
permanent_address.ask_hint: HDFC only: collect permanent address; confirm if same as correspondence.

pan.label: PAN
pan.ask_hint: Collect PAN letter-by-letter and digit-by-digit; never ask customer to WhatsApp/email PAN.

aadhaar_number.label: Aadhaar number
aadhaar_number.ask_hint: ICICI only: collect Aadhaar number carefully; prefer guiding approved digital KYC path when available.

aadhaar_images.label: Aadhaar images
aadhaar_images.ask_hint: Never collect images on the call. Guide customer to the approved KYC/WhatsApp/app upload path.

gstin.label: GSTIN
gstin.ask_hint: Collect GSTIN when the proposal is business/GST applicable.

pep.label: PEP
pep.ask_hint: Ask whether the customer or related party is a Politically Exposed Person; record yes/no as required.

indian.label: Indian
indian.ask_hint: HDFC only: confirm Indian nationality / residency status required by form.

profile_photo.label: Profile photo
profile_photo.ask_hint: HDFC only: never collect photo on the call; guide approved upload path.

cin.label: CIN
cin.ask_hint: AIG only: collect Corporate Identification Number when applicable.

nominee.label: Nominee
nominee.ask_hint: Collect nominee name and any required relationship/share fields supported by the form.

call_phases.goal: Load case context: proposal_id, insurer_id/label, payment state, KYC/proposal status, already-known fields.
State who is calling, why (post-payment KYC/proposal completion), and get consent to continue.
Compute required field set for insurer minus already-present verified fields.
call_phases.runtime_rule: required = requirement_matrix fields for insurer_id; skip fields marked present+verified in live case payload.

call_phases.goal: Collect voice-allowed missing fields in recommended order; confirm by read-back.
For upload-only fields, send/remind approved digital path; do not accept media on the call.
Do not close from verbal confirmation alone; confirm KYC/proposal progression from live system evidence.
Record privacy-safe disposition, missing fields remaining, upload pending, callback needed, or escalation.

safety_rules: Never invent insurer requirements not present in this graph.
Never ask for OTP on the call.
Never ask customer to send Aadhaar/PAN/profile images over general WhatsApp/email/chat unless that channel is the approved KYC path for the case.
Never store raw Aadhaar/PAN/full address payloads in wiki notes, training dumps, or unrestricted logs.
Never mark KYC/proposal complete from verbal confirmation alone.
If insurer is Kotak or otherwise unmapped, collect only universal fields after stating mapping is incomplete, then escalate for confirmed field list.
If live case evidence conflicts with this matrix, prefer live owning-system evidence and flag the conflict.

app_flow._source: Park+ app screenshots (full set) + product owner walkthrough, 2026-09-18. Field labels are verbatim — the bot says them aloud while the customer is looking at them.
entry_path: on it, tap the "Complete KYC" button
the Confirm policy details form opens

declaration.label: I hereby declare that the details mentioned above are to the best of my knowledge
declaration.note: The button below stays disabled until this is ticked.

proposal_page.title: Confirm policy details
proposal_page.how_to_guide: Do NOT read the fields out one by one. Tell them to fill it in, say you are waiting, then stop. Step in per-field only when they ask or report an error. Six fields on this page are BLANK and the customer types them (owner's name, email, current address, and all three nominee fields); eight arrive pre-filled. Never describe a customer_fills field as already filled — on the 00:50 call that sent someone to tick the declaration and press Next on an empty form.

fields.label: Car Owner's name (as per RC)
fields.help: their own name, exactly as on the RC and the Aadhaar card

fields.label: Date of birth
fields.help: the car owner's own date of birth, day/month/year

fields.label: Email Id
fields.help: their own email — the policy is sent to it

fields.label: Current Address
fields.help: special characters are rejected — no comma, no slash, no dash, no hash. Words and numbers separated by spaces only. This is the commonest reason the address 'looks right' but will not submit.

fields.label: Was the car purchased on loan?
Previous Own Damage Insurer policy number

kyc_page.title: KYC DETAILS
kyc_page.how_to_guide: Do NOT recite the document list. The customer can see the page. Tell them to complete everything and that you are on the line to help. Answer WHICH documents are needed only if they ask, and then answer for their ownership type only.
kyc_page.on_screen_warning: The name on your Aadhar must match the one submitted on the previous page
failure_warnings: A full-size or folded Aadhaar printout is photographed in two shots: the side with the photo and name goes in Aadhar Front Image, the side with the address goes in Aadhar Back Image. NEVER tell a customer to cut, tear or damage the card.
The Aadhaar number must be typed exactly right. One wrong digit and the KYC fails and has to be redone.

fields.label: Full Name
fields.hint: Enter name as per Aadhaar card

insurer_flows._note: The KYC page above is the normal path. United does not use it.

united.label: United (UIIC)
united.how: United's KYC runs on our own platform. When the proposal page is submitted it redirects to HyperVerge, and everything happens there.
steps: fill the proposal page and submit it as usual
the app redirects to HyperVerge on its own — they do not go looking for it
take a LIVE photo of the Aadhaar card, front
take a LIVE photo of the Aadhaar card, back
united.note: Live capture, not an upload from the gallery — there is no Browse button in this flow. Same as the normal page otherwise: no number is read out on the call.

ownership_types._note: Which set applies is decided by the ownership the customer selected for the policy. It changes WHICH documents the KYC page asks for. The bot does not choose it and does not ask the customer to choose it — it only needs to know both sets so it can answer a question.

company_owned_car.label: company-owned car
company_owned_car.note: No Aadhaar at all for a company-owned car — not the number and not the images.

stt_keyterms: Previous Own Damage Insurer policy number
Was the car purchased on loan?
stt_prompt: A phone call in Hindi and English between a Park+ Insurance agent and a customer completing KYC for a motor insurance policy. The agent guides the customer through the Park+ app: the Insurance section, the Complete KYC button, PAN and Aadhaar details, and the nominee and address fields.

refund_or_cancel._source: Park+ product owner, 2026-09-22, after a live call. The caller said "मेरे को चाहिए नहीं पॉलिसी" and the bot answered "मुझे इसका exact जवाब पता नहीं है — team confirm करके बात कर लेगी", which leaves them nowhere. Refunds and cancellations are out of scope for THIS call, but Park+ customer support handles them, and saying so is the answer.
refund_or_cancel.answer: Refunds and cancellations are handled by Park+ customer support, not on this call. Point them there plainly; never quote an amount, a timeline or whether a refund will be approved.
refund_or_cancel.still_unknown: Whether any refund is due, how much, and how long it takes. Never say. Only that customer support is the place to ask.
refund_or_cancel.sanctioned_line: सर, policy cancel या refund की request आप Park+ customer support पर कर सकते हैं — वो लोग यही handle करते हैं।

claim_support._source: Park+ product owner, 2026-09-23. Customers ask what happens at claim time; the bot had no answer.
claim_support.answer: A policy bought through Park+ gets a dedicated Park+ claim-assistance person once it is issued, for any trouble at claim time. The insurer settles the claim; Park+ helps them through it.
claim_support.still_unknown: Claim amounts, timelines, approval, what is covered, how to reach the claim person. Never say — only that Park+ gives dedicated claim help after the policy is issued.
claim_support.sanctioned_line: सर, policy issue होने के बाद अगर कभी claim में कोई दिक्कत आए, तो Park+ की तरफ़ से एक dedicated claim assistance मिलता है — वो पूरे claim में आपकी help करेंगे।

rewards._source: Park+ product owner, 2026-09-23. There is no reward for completing KYC or buying insurance right now.
rewards.answer: No reward, cashback, coupon, points or discount is given for completing KYC or the insurance. Never promise one, never hint at one.
rewards.sanctioned_line: सर, KYC complete करने पर अभी कोई reward या cashback नहीं है — बस आपकी policy बन जाएगी।
